### initRepo

Write or update the hookset wiring in `repo`. A lefthook.yml hookset did not write is refused
unless `force`, which puts the remotes block on top and keeps every hand-written step (`check`
then names the duplicates to delete). `claude` also vendors the Claude pack.

```ts
function initRepo(repo: string, pkg: string, options?: {
    force?: boolean;
    claude?: boolean;
}): InitResult;
```

| Parameter | Type |
| :-- | :-- |
| `repo` | `string` |
| `pkg` | `string` |
| `options` (optional) | `{ force?: boolean; claude?: boolean; }` |

**Returns** `InitResult`

### parseRemotes

The `remotes:` entries of a lefthook.yml. Read line by line: hookset writes this block itself,
and a full YAML parser would be this package's only dependency. A remote starts at a list item
whose first word is one of its keys; a configs entry is a list item that is a path.

```ts
function parseRemotes(yaml: string): Remote[];
```

| Parameter | Type |
| :-- | :-- |
| `yaml` | `string` |

**Returns** `Remote[]`

## Constants

### coverage

Which packages the change ships, and which of them no changeset names.

```ts
const coverage: (input: CoverageInput) => Coverage;
```

### coverageText

The result as a person reads it, ending with the fix when a package is not covered.

```ts
const coverageText: (result: Coverage) => string;
```

### DEFAULT_PATHS

The files that can need a changeset, as the gate's `paths` input names them.

```ts
const DEFAULT_PATHS: string;
```

### devOnly

A manifest whose only change is `devDependencies`, given its text at the base and at the head.

```ts
const devOnly: (base: string | undefined, head: string | undefined) => boolean;
```

### isChangeset

A changeset file: a markdown file directly under .changeset/, other than its README.

```ts
const isChangeset: (path: string) => boolean;
```

### releasesOf

The package names a changeset's front matter releases.

```ts
const releasesOf: (text: string) => string[];
```

## Interfaces

### CheckResult

```ts
interface CheckResult {
    ok: boolean;
    /** The `hookset@…` tag the repo pins, when it pins one. */
    pinned: string | undefined;
    expected: string;
    problems: Problem[];
}
```

### ClaudeHook

```ts
interface ClaudeHook {
    event: string;
    matcher: string;
    file: string;
    /** Seconds before Claude Code kills the hook. Required: a pack hook never runs unbounded. */
    timeout: number;
}
```

### ClaudeMcp

An MCP server every repo runs: written into .mcp.json, its index folder gitignored, its tools allowed.

```ts
interface ClaudeMcp {
    id: string;
    detail: string;
    /** The `.mcp.json` entry, written as is under `mcpServers.<id>`. */
    server: {
        type: string;
        command: string;
        args: string[];
        env?: Record<string, string>;
    };
    /** What the server puts in every session (its instructions and tool definitions), in characters. */
    contextChars: number;
    contextSource: string;
    /** The folder the server writes into the repo, which .gitignore must list. */
    ignore: string;
    /** The tool names settings.json allows without a prompt. */
    allow: string[];
}
```

### ClaudeSkill

A skill every repo carries, such as `verify`: written from a template, then filled in by the repo.

```ts
interface ClaudeSkill {
    id: string;
    /** Where the repo keeps it, relative to the repo root. */
    path: string;
    /** The template `init --claude` writes, relative to the package root. */
    template: string;
    /** Text the filled-in skill still has to contain. */
    requires: string[];
    /** The marker the template puts on every line the repo has to replace. */
    placeholder: string;
    detail: string;
}
```

### Coverage

```ts
interface Coverage {
    /** The changesets the pull request adds or edits. */
    readonly changesets: readonly string[];
    /** Every package with a shipped change, by name. */
    readonly needed: readonly Needed[];
    /** The packages no changeset names. */
    readonly uncovered: readonly Needed[];
}
```

### CoverageInput

```ts
interface CoverageInput {
    /** The checkout of the pull request's head. */
    readonly root: string;
    /** Every path the pull request changes, from `git diff --name-only <base>...<head>`. */
    readonly changed: readonly string[];
    /** A file's text at the merge base, `undefined` when it did not exist there. */
    readonly baseText: (path: string) => string | undefined;
    /** The regular expression over paths that can need a changeset. */
    readonly paths?: string | undefined;
}
```

### InitResult

```ts
interface InitResult {
    changed: boolean;
    written: string[];
    refused?: string;
}
```

### Needed

```ts
interface Needed {
    readonly name: string;
    /** The folder under the repository, `packages/<dir>`. */
    readonly dir: string;
    /** The shipped files that changed in it. */
    readonly files: readonly string[];
}
```

### Problem

```ts
interface Problem {
    id: string;
    severity: 'error' | 'warning';
    message: string;
    fix: string;
}
```

### Remote

```ts
interface Remote {
    gitUrl: string;
    ref: string | undefined;
    configs: string[];
}
```

### Run

```ts
interface Run {
    hook: string;
    command: string;
    run: string;
}
```

### Station

```ts
interface Station {
    id: string;
    hook: Hook;
    mode: Mode;
    /** The command name the preset gives this station's step. */
    command: string;
    /** The repo script the step runs, when the repo decides what the station does. */
    script?: string;
    detail: string;
}
```

### Stations

```ts
interface Stations {
    remote: string;
    tagPrefix: string;
    presets: Record<Hook, string>;
    stations: Station[];
    claude: {
        files: string[];
        hooks: ClaudeHook[];
        skills: ClaudeSkill[];
        mcp: ClaudeMcp[];
    };
}
```
